title: AtomicReadFile record-mode coverage seed
purpose: Exercise confirmed FILE object read parsing on the record-access path to complement the write-focused issue seeds and broaden file-service coverage.
expected_behavior: Target parses an AtomicReadFile confirmed request and returns file data, EOF indication, or an application error if the addressed FILE object is absent or not readable.
constraints_preserved: BVLC total length 0x0013 matches message size
Confirmed service choice 0x06 preserved for AtomicReadFile
Request framed as BACnet/IP with NPDU followed by APDU
Record-oriented style kept simple and boundary-adjacent without oversized counts
issue_safety_notes: Read-only analogue avoids the append and replacement hazards described in the RAMFS write issues.
